editor.hstg_permissions.tooltip.commands: Lock or grant commands with this stage
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.bad_path: %1$s is not a command path. Write it like minecraft.gamemode.creative, mod.* or *.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.bad_mode: %1$s has the mode '%2$s'. Pick Lock or Grant.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.protecte: %1$s is on the protected list and can only be locked. This grant does nothing. The list is in the server config.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.never_lo: %1$s belongs to History Stages or HSTG: Permissions, which can never be locked. This lock does nothing.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.not_foun: %1$s does not exist on this server. A typo, or the mod is missing. The entry stays and works once the command exists.
editor.hstg_permissions.picker.unavailab: This server sends no command list.
